commands.name: pull_error_and_inline_bench_flow
commands.command: MLX_STACK_HOME=/tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/tooling-g2 uv run mlx-stack pull scenarios (invalid model, network failure/retry, bf16 conversion failure, pull --bench)

assertionResults.reason: int4 pull used mlx-community source and bf16 pull resolved to convert-from source (`google/gemma-3-4b-it`) with `Type: converted`.
Network failure path did clean up partial download directory, but user-facing output included a long raw traceback from underlying HF CLI rather than a concise clean error.
Invalid model ID returned clear non-zero error and suggested `mlx-stack models --catalog`.
Conversion failure produced explicit mlx_lm module error output and removed partial target directory.
Transient failure simulation showed automatic second attempt and final message suggesting network/HF authentication checks when retry also failed.
`pull --bench` downloaded model but benchmark phase timed out waiting for temporary vllm instance health and produced no saved benchmark artifact.

frictions.description: `huggingface-cli` binary name no longer present in modern huggingface_hub; only `hf` exists by default.
frictions.resolution: Created temporary `/tmp/huggingface-cli` wrapper delegating to `hf` to continue validation.
